notes_for_editor: The NGS datasheet names the point Brunswick Lot, while tnlandforms calls the tower Lakeland. The link rests on the shared PID FE2549 (listed on the tnlandforms row for Lakeland) and the datasheet's Shelby County lookout-tower marker. The datasheet position is about 17 m from the list's towers.gpx waypoint (35.2402, -89.7618); that coordinate comparison is not cited because the coordinates are XML attributes the quote checker cannot read, and the story no longer relies on it. This is a match by identifier and location, not a stated identity. height_m was removed on 2026-10-21: the 89 ft figure is the steel structure's height above ground under a station at the roof apex, which sits above the cab floor, so it is not the cab-floor height the guide asks for. The 1958 recovery note is a plan; no source read confirms the replacement's completion or the old tower's destruction, and the story says only what the note says. The agency rests on the 9-19 Division code. The Millington NHLR tower (US 1763, Shelby County) was relocated from Arkansas and is not this tower. Access is not stated; the story mentions the datasheet's 1958 road directions only to say they are too old to show whether the land is open. Two web searches were spent on this tower, plus one NGS datasheet read and the shared list and NRHP reads.
